scope: Mask-supervised continuation diagnostic; separate from every unsupervised leaderboard. A short run is not an absolute architecture ceiling.

source.core: Immutable SW0097 seed1 native16-trained whole checkpoint, strictly mapped to native32 by frozen SW0135
source.graph: SW0135 linear cosine dissimilarity; learned source contrast; full-k soft min-plus reduction with temperature*log(4) correction
source.encoder: Registered native RGB encoder/statistics plus SW0152 exact-zero-output residual; original base encoder frozen
source.initialization: Both arms use identical source, residual weights, and fresh Adam state; no completed SW0152 training checkpoint reuse
source.training_lineage: Pretrained source continuation, not fresh native32 70k training

data.mask_schema: Nonnegative integer native128 instance IDs, [100000,128,128] or [100000,128,128,1]; background ID0
data.ordered_selection: First2048 images in the immutable SW0097 seed1 ordered4096 TRAIN source contract; select RGB and mask by identical global ID and restore that exact order after sorted HDF5 reads
data.mask_cache: Optional TRAIN-only cache binding ordered global IDs, canonical dataset identity, RGB mapping and mask bytes; never create an all-split mask cache
data.ground_truth_permitted: TRAIN masks only; explicit user-authorized supervision
data.official_tfds_warning: SW0107 export contains image/tfds_train_index and no masks. Never attach canonical masks by matching TFDS row numbers.

target.conversion: Production clevr_mask_patch: modal instance ID, smallest-ID tie, retain mixed/BG patches
target.pairs: Unordered off-diagonal pairs i<j; exclude self pairs; no purity filtering
target.same_target: Y=1 for same foreground instance and background-background, otherwise Y=0
target.balancing: For each image, mean within every nonempty pair class, then mean those class means, then mean images. Empty classes contribute neither value nor denominator.

objective.signed_correlations: Exact production per-component centered/epsilon-normalized Pearson arithmetic on actual emitted component_spikes settled frames512:1024
objective.positive_credit: For each nonempty positive class (same-FG and BG-BG), mean over pairs of mean_d (1-rho_d)^2; average positive-class means per image and then images. This supplies credit to positive pairs blocked by native positive-clamp.
objective.coefficient_selection: None; no validation calibration or sweep

arms.encoder_graph: Train residual encoder and learned graph; freeze all non-graph native-core parameters and all three integration tensors
arms.joint: Same residual encoder and graph plus every non-graph native-core parameter and integration a_d/a_m/b
arms.integration_parameter_accounting: a_d,a_m,b are THREE Parameter tensors of length4: TWELVE scalar elements, not three scalars
arms.shared: Frozen base encoder, matched source, identical ordered TRAIN IDs and exposure budget, no additional mask classifier or external teacher

optimization.aggregation: Sum micro image-mean losses divided by4; global clip and Adam once per logical update
optimization.optimizer: Fresh Adam, default beta/epsilon and no weight decay, restored exactly on interruption
optimization.static_preparation: Graph, drive and coupling prepared live before no-grad burn-in; native states detached only at step960
optimization.completion: Last completed update128 only; transactional weights/Adam/RNG/history checkpoint after each full logical update; no validation checkpoint selection

preflight: Validate raw mask schema and exact RGB/mask/global-ID alignment on TRAIN only; reject any forbidden IDs before mask access
Synthetic unordered-label, empty-class, BG, mixed-patch/tie and pair-balancing checks
Exact source zero-residual gamma/actual-spike/QCC parity; independent production Q versus reconstructed positive-product equality
Two disposable logical updates for each arm with finite loss/gradient and actual changes in intended groups; confirm frozen groups unchanged and preserve fresh source for pilot
First-update hidden residual gradients may be zero because final projection is zero; inspect hidden credit on update2
Measure exclusive-GPU peak/time, per-family gradient/update and actual event occupancy/change; tiny surrogate gradients do not establish gate usefulness

evaluation.prediction: Original actual-spike QCC, threshold0.50, minimum group8, largest connected component BG; no GT or GT object count at inference
evaluation.freeze_rule: Freeze both arms and source predictions/provenance before evaluator opens VAL masks
evaluation.checkpoint: Last only; both arms reported regardless of result
evaluation.reference: Same-seed source plus SW0143T incumbent reported separately; existing unsupervised Slot is contextual, not a supervised matched training control
evaluation.supervised_slot: Separate registered Slot continuation on identical canonical TRAIN masks/images/exposures;11 fixed output slots, Hungarian mask BCE+Dice, no inference object count and unchanged perimeter BG policy

decision.expansion: Extend promising supervised recipe to seeds0/2 only if FG gain>=0.02 over same-seed SW0143T and shared-image paired95% CI lower>0; joint superiority claim additionally requires positive CI versus encoder_graph
decision.iou_policy: Report both IoUs; retain useful FG-first tradeoffs under SELECTION_POLICY; final goal still requires all three comparable metrics
decision.failure: Close this fixed short recipe if endpoint does not advance; no LR/target/readout/threshold sweep. Failure is not proof of an absolute ceiling.
decision.goal_claim: Native32 FG>=0.87 must be verified as seed0/1/2 mean. Supervised success does not satisfy the unsupervised70k goal, all-gates contribution, or unique-data scaling claim.
